integrity: A combinatorial proof is supplied, with a standalone finite checker. No external independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to binary alphabets at length 2k+1. Published equivalent formulations may exist outside inspected literature. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the infinite statement.
scientific_scope: Every binary circularly k-universal word of length 2k+1, k>=1; exact labeled, necklace and bracelet enumeration.
title: Near-minimal binary circular subsequence covers: parity classification and exact orbit counts
